preview.model.architecture.comment: Field label in the summary of a machine-learning model file (GGUF or safetensors): the model architecture family, for example llama. The value next to it is a technical name and is not translated. Technical names such as GGUF, LoRA and GPTQ stay as they are. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.sizeLabel.comment: Field label in the summary of a machine-learning model file (GGUF): the size class the model's author wrote, such as 7B or 8x7B. The value is a short code and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.parameters.comment: Field label in the summary of a machine-learning model file (GGUF or safetensors): the total number of trainable values (weights) in the model, counted from the tensor shapes. Also the label of the same count for one tensor in the tensor list. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.fileType.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the quantization name the file declares, for example Q4_K_M. The value is a technical name and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.bitsPerWeight.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the average number of bits that store one weight, with two decimals, for example 4.85. Lower numbers mean a smaller, more compressed model. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.bitsPerWeight.ja: 重み1つあたりのビット数

preview.model.tensorTypes.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: how many tensors are stored in each numeric format. Its children are technical type names such as F32 or Q4_K with a count; the names are not translated. A tensor is one array of weights. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.contextLength.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the longest input, counted in tokens, that the model was trained to handle at once. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.blockCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the number of layers (transformer blocks) the model stacks. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.embeddingLength.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the width of the vector (embedding) that represents one token inside the model, a plain number. Keep the established machine-learning word for embedding where the language has one. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.headCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the number of attention heads in each layer of the model (a machine-learning term, not a body part). Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.headCount.ja: アテンションヘッド数

preview.model.headCountKV.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the number of key/value attention heads in each layer (a machine-learning term; fewer than the attention heads when the model shares them). Keep the slash. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.headCountKV.ja: キー／バリューヘッド数

preview.model.expertCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the number of experts in a mixture-of-experts model, meaning separate sub-networks of which only a few run per token. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.expertUsedCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: how many experts of a mixture-of-experts model run for each token. A token is a small piece of text the model reads. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.expertUsedCount.zh-Hans: 每个词元使用的专家数
preview.model.expertUsedCount.ja: トークンごとに使うエキスパート数
preview.model.expertUsedCount.hi: प्रति टोकन उपयोग किए गए विशेषज्ञ
preview.model.expertUsedCount.ku-Latn: Pisporên ku ji bo her tokenê tên bikaranîn
preview.model.expertUsedCount.ha: Ƙwararrun da ake amfani da su ga kowane token

preview.model.vocabularySize.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the number of distinct tokens (small pieces of text) in the model's vocabulary. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.tokenizer.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the name of the tokenizer, the component that splits text into tokens. The value is a technical name such as llama or gpt2 and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.license.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the licence the model's author declared, usually a short licence identifier such as apache-2.0. The value is written by the file's author and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.author.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the person or team that the file names as the model's author. The value is written by the file's author and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.organization.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the organization that the file names as publishing the model. The value is written by the file's author and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.quantizedBy.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: who converted the model to a smaller numeric format (quantized it). The value is a name written by the file's author and is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.baseModels.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the models this one was fine-tuned or derived from; the children are model names written by the file's author and are not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.tags.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: search tags the file's author attached to the model; the children are short words that are not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.languages.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the languages the model was trained for, as two-letter language codes written by the file's author; the codes are not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.chatTemplate.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the chat template, a small piece of code stored in the file that tells a program how to lay out a conversation for this model. The value is the template's text, shown as inert text and never run; it is not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.chatTemplate.ja: チャットテンプレート

preview.model.chatTemplateBytes.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the full size of the chat template in bytes, shown when the text above it is cut short. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.chatTemplateBytes.ja: チャットテンプレートのサイズ（バイト）
preview.model.chatTemplateBytes.es: Tamaño de la plantilla de chat (bytes)

preview.model.ggufVersion.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the version number of the GGUF file format, 2 or 3. GGUF is a file format name and stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.alignment.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the byte boundary, usually 32, that each tensor's data starts on. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.alignment.ja: アラインメント（バイト）

preview.model.tensorCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a machine-learning model file (GGUF or safetensors): how many tensors (arrays of weights) the file describes. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.metadataCount.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: how many key/value entries of metadata the file declares. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.otherMetadata.comment: Field label in the summary of a GGUF model file: the metadata entries that have no field of their own. Its children are the file's own key names, which are not translated, with their values; arrays are shown as an item count. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.tensors.comment: Field label in the summary of a machine-learning model file (GGUF or safetensors): the list of tensors (arrays of weights) with each one's name, type, shape and parameter count. It may show only the first ones of a very large model. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.dtypes.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: how many tensors are stored in each numeric data type. Its children are technical type names such as F32 or BF16 with a count; the names are not translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.shard.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: which piece of a model split over several files this file is, for example 2 of 5. A shard is one part of a split file. The value is written by the app and reads like 2 of 5. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.adapterKind.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: the kind of add-on weights the file holds, for example LoRA, a small set of weights that adjusts a larger model. The value (LoRA) is a technical name and stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.loraRank.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: the rank of a LoRA adapter, a small whole number such as 16 that sets how large the adapter is. LoRA is a technical name and stays as it is; rank is the mathematical term. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.quantization.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: the quantization scheme recognized from the tensor names, for example GPTQ or AWQ, which store weights in fewer bits. The value (GPTQ, AWQ) is a technical name and stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.model.headerBytes.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: the size in bytes of the JSON header that describes the tensors. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.headerBytes.ja: ヘッダーのサイズ（バイト）

preview.model.dataBytes.comment: Field label in the summary of a safetensors model file: how many bytes of tensor data the header accounts for, the weights that follow the header. The number next to it is formatted by the app. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.model.dataBytes.ja: テンソルデータのサイズ（バイト）
preview.model.dataBytes.es: Tamaño de los datos de tensores (bytes)
